time-tracker.title: Time Trackerígena
time-tracker.short_desc: Robust time-tracking system featuring multiple user workflows, calendar integrations, and a secure admin panel.
time-tracker.description: A comprehensive time management and tracking platform, developed with React and Flask integrated with PostgreSQL.
time-tracker.what_is: Time Trackerígena is a corporate product designed for freelancers and teams who need analytical and detailed tracking of hours worked on specific projects, generating smart invoices and visual reports.
time-tracker.how_i_did: The front-end architecture is modularized in React, leveraging the Context API for session persistence and translation keys. On the back-end, Flask with SQLAlchemy was used, establishing 1:N database relationships for calendar events, and encapsulated in PostgreSQL for higher scalability.
time-tracker.why_design: For the design, we opted for a clean corporate dashboard style, with wide visibility of temporal filters (monthly, weekly) and real-time feedback via responsive modals and subtle transitions.
time-tracker.challenges: The main challenge was decoupling the linear calendar architecture to support multiple independent task schedules without corrupting the original project state. We solved this by creating an intermediate events table with strict concurrency control in the database.

space-portfolio.title: 3D Space Portfolio
space-portfolio.short_desc: Space-themed landing page featuring 3D elements in Three.js, interactive particles, and scroll paralax animations.
space-portfolio.description: An immersive 3D interactive journey through stars and planets, designed using React Three Fiber and Framer Motion.
space-portfolio.what_is: This is a high-fidelity visual web project simulating a space journey where each section of the page represents a different orbit or celestial body showcasing developer details.
space-portfolio.how_i_did: Built upon React Three Fiber (R3F) and @react-three/drei, it leverages the GPU loop via the `useFrame` hook to synchronize planet rotations and particle gravity points directly with the page's vertical scroll.
space-portfolio.why_design: A glassmorphism style was adopted with a procedurally generated galaxy background using custom fragment shaders in the particles, creating high-contrast blue and purple neon glows with modern typography.
space-portfolio.challenges: Maintaining high frame rates (60 FPS) on mobile devices and managing the sudden snapping camera behavior when scrolling. The solution involved implementing smooth transitions using linear interpolation (lerp) mathematical functions and dynamic performance levels to skip complex shadows on smaller screens.

ai-assistant-integrator.title: AI Integrator & Organic Chatbot
ai-assistant-integrator.short_desc: Reactive interface connected to LLMs, featuring encrypted local history, vector search, and streaming responses.
ai-assistant-integrator.description: An intelligent chat panel integrated with multiple AI APIs supporting real-time text streaming.
ai-assistant-integrator.what_is: The AI Integrator is a tool for developers to easily experiment with different language models, also allowing document uploads and local query via vector similarity search (RAG).
ai-assistant-integrator.how_i_did: Developed with Node.js on the back-end and React on the front-end, the system uses network stream routes (Server-Sent Events) to continuously render incoming token answers in real-time from APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude).
ai-assistant-integrator.why_design: The interface features a reading-focused design, with dialog boxes in a futuristic terminal style, integrated markdown code codeblocks, and a responsive floating conversation layout.
ai-assistant-integrator.challenges: Managing the continuous flow of network-streamed tokens without causing sudden rendering lags on the viewport. This was solved by creating a custom React state hook that queues incoming chunk buffers and batches UI updates periodically.
